title: Ambassador Hotel moves Delhi High Court against eviction notice
description: The Delhi High Court on Thursday issued notice to the Central government and the Land and Development Office (L&DO) on a plea challenging the eviction proceedings initiated under the Public Premises Act in the case related to the Sujan Singh Park area, which includes the iconic Ambassador Hotel. Justice Harish Vaidyanathan Shankar asked the parties to file their replies in three weeks on the plea filed by Sir Sobha Singh & Sons Private Limited - the company that owns the h
